sections.heading: Who we are
paragraphs: cheatsisle.com is a Windows PC store for The Isle Cheats, The Isle HWID Spoofer, and The Isle Unban Tool. The cheat is one product with Visual and Misc modules. It is not a ladder of Lite, Pro, and Elite tiers, and it is not a DMA card.

The cheat and UGC are $35 for 30 days or $150 lifetime. The HWID spoofer is $50 for 30 days or $150 lifetime. A lifetime key on the cheat does not include the spoofer or the recovery workspace. Starting on a month does not promise a credit toward lifetime.

Product names on this site identify what we sell. They are not a claim that the game publisher endorses the software. Delivery is a portal download for Windows 10 or 11. You keep HVCI, core isolation, TPM, and secure boot on, then open the loader only when the site still matches the current client.

sections.heading: What we publish
paragraphs: The [The Isle Cheats](/product/the-isle-cheat/) page lists the menu names and the Windows requirements: Windows 10 or 11, Intel or AMD, with HVCI, core isolation, TPM, and secure boot left on. The [products page](/products/) is where you compare the cheat, the [The Isle HWID Spoofer](/product/spoofer/), and [The Isle Unban Tool](/product/ugc/).

The [forum](/forum/) covers ESP distance tuning, forage markers, and why a hardware flag is a different buy from an account appeal, with developer replies marked on the thread. Read the [terms](/terms/) before checkout. Sales are final, including bans.

Easy Anti-Cheat can still act on an account. Nothing here is a guarantee that a session stays clean after the next patch. Check this site after a client update before you open the loader. If the page is not current for that build, leave the software closed.

Status notes on the homepage describe whether the published build still matches the client. They are not a promise that Easy Anti-Cheat will ignore the software. If you are unsure, leave the loader closed and read the matching guide on the blog before you launch again.

sections.heading: Support
paragraphs: Loader errors, a key that will not move, and checkout questions go through the [support page](/support/). Include your order ID from checkout, Windows version, and the exact loader text. Do not turn HVCI, core isolation, TPM, or secure boot off because a chat message from another game said to.
